name: Trixie
source:
Age: 3 years, 8 months
Breed: Calico American Shorthair 
Likes: Dancing through the night, A sparkling aura, Laughing until she cries
Dislikes: A closed mind, Party Poopers, Blocked chakras

This flower child is all about those good vibes. Will your signs be compatible?
